name: Telegram
summary: Talk to Alexia from Telegram. Every message crosses Telegram's servers, and every reply says so.

requires.why: To hold a connection open to Telegram and collect the messages you send it.
To hold a voice note for a moment while it is turned into words, then drop it.

settings.label: Bot token
settings.hint: From @BotFather on Telegram. Send it /newbot and it hands you one. It goes to this machine's credential store, never to the database.

settings.label: Answer with a voice note
settings.hint: Only works while a cloned voice is chosen in Voice — that is the one that makes the format a voice bubble takes. Otherwise replies are text.

settings.label: ntfy topic, if Telegram is down
settings.hint: A fallback and never a replacement: no buttons, no threading, and anyone who knows the topic can read it. Leave it empty and nothing is sent anywhere else.

settings.label: Pairing code
settings.hint: Send this code to your bot from the Telegram account you want to allow. Nobody else is answered.

settings.label: Forget who is allowed
settings.hint: Clears the allowed accounts and makes a new pairing code. Do this if the old one got out.

commands.name: paired
commands.summary: Who is allowed to reach Alexia from Telegram
